description: Registered calls admit one schema-lifecycle job and return its job_id/status before declaration parsing or lifecycle effects. Idempotent install / adoption / additive update for a plugin's declared schema. Tables not on disk: CREATE. Tables on disk that match declared shape: adopt (legacy column-type normalization, index reconciliation). Identical re-install: no-op. Previously uninstalled namespace: reactivate. Different shape: diff-and-update (additive — never drops tables). Use serialization.to_json to convert a SchemaDefinition into the declared_schema_json dict.
embedding_description: Queue the complete schema lifecycle operation and read its exact job for the final outcome. Install or update the persistent table schema for a plugin namespace from a declared SchemaDefinition JSON shape. Idempotent and additive — creates new tables, adopts existing ones with legacy types, applies column/index changes in a single transaction. Does not drop tables; use uninstall or purge for that.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued ActionResult receipt with data.job_id and data.status; the exact job.result retains the complete original lifecycle response and job.error its typed failure.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Admission confirms the job was persisted, not that the schema changed. Read service_interface::job_service::get_job by this exact id until terminal before using lifecycle status, tables or force results.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Poll the exact job id. Preserve the existing force and ownership premises. Reconcile an uncertain outcome or lost volatile declaration without replaying schema effects.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Installs (or adopts / updates) the plugin's declared schema in the live database via the plugin-schema lifecycle service. All DDL + ownership-row writes happen in a single transaction.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValueError: declared_schema_json mismatched the namespace, or SchemaDefinition.validate() failed. NotImplementedError: declared shape requires an unsupported transition (column type change, with_history toggle, id_prefix change). AdoptionDivergence: live tables diverge from declared in a way outside the whitelisted legacy normalizations. Postgres errors propagate from the transactional apply — failure rolls back atomically.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For ValueError: confirm the JSON shape matches serialization.to_json output and the namespace argument matches schema_def.namespace. For NotImplementedError on type/structural changes: drop and re-add the column manually, or purge_plugin_schema and reinstall. For AdoptionDivergence: surface the divergence message to the operator; manual SQL reconciliation is required before retry. For Postgres errors: the transaction rolled back; the database is in the pre-call state.
